$comment: SHARED CONTRACT - the DECLARATION TOKENS: every word this system uses to say what a
map metadata blob DECLARES about its geometry and orientation.
THE SERVER IS CANONICAL. These are captured FROM map_overlay.GEOMETRY_TOKENS, and the
server-side test asserts EQUALITY rather than containment: move a token on the server
and this file goes red, so the vectors are updated DELIBERATELY instead of drifting.
The client measures itself against this file as a SUBSET, because a client that has
not learned a new token yet is behind - not wrong.
WHY IT EXISTS. The client froze these seven in DECLARATION_TOKENS; the server had no
name binding them at all. Asymmetric, one side could add a token and the other would
say nothing - which is the shape where two answers about one map quietly diverge.
